subject.title: Chula Vista Elementary School District Board, Seat 3

text: I am running for Chula Vista Elementary School District Board Trustee, Seat #3, because I believe every child deserves a high-quality education, a safe and supportive school environment, and the opportunity to reach their full potential.

As a 25+ year special education teacher, I have dedicated my career to serving students with diverse learning and social emotional needs and supporting families as they navigate the educational system. I am honored to have been recognized as Teacher of the Year three times, an achievement that reflects my commitment to students, collaboration, and excellence in education.

My work extends beyond the classroom. As a special education advocate, I work with students and families to help ensure that children receive the services, support, and opportunities they deserve. I understand the importance of listening to parents, respecting educators, and making decisions based on what is best for students.

I also bring direct experience in school board leadership. Having previously served as a school board trustee and treasurer, I understand the responsibilities that come with governing a school district, including fiscal stewardship, accountability, transparency, and thoughtful decision-making. I believe our schools must be both educationally strong and financially responsible.

Service to my community is also a personal priority. As a community volunteer and Charity Chair, I have worked to support local charities and connect resources with people and organizations in need. These experiences have strengthened my belief that strong communities are built through service, compassion, and collaboration.

I am running to bring my experience as an educator, mother, advocate, school board leader, and community volunteer to the Chula Vista Elementary School District Board Trustee, Seat #3. I will listen to families, support our teachers and staff, promote responsible use of taxpayer dollars, and keep students at the center of every decision.
Our children deserve leaders who will listen, lead with integrity, and put students first.
I, Katina Gonzalez Rondeau, am ready to serve.
Your vote is your voice!

text: Leticia Segura brings 34 years of experience in public education to her service on the Chula Vista Elementary School District Board. She has served as a Speech-Language Pathologist, Assistant Principal, Special Education Coordinator, and school principal before retiring in June 2026. Her professional experience includes a Master’s in Communicative Disorders and a Doctorate in Educational Leadership. She has supported student achievement, led school improvement efforts, overseen school operations, and collaborated with educators, families, and community partners.

A graduate of Chula Vista Elementary schools, Leticia raised three children who attended schools in the district. Her professional connections to the district have shaped her understanding of the importance of strong public schools and collaborative leadership. As a trustee, she will prioritize student safety, student academic growth, fiscal responsibility, teacher and staff support, family engagement, and ensuring that all students feel valued, respected, and welcomed.

Student Safety: Leticia considers student and staff safety a fundamental responsibility of every school. As a principal, she served on her school’s Safety Committee and led the development of the Comprehensive School Safety Plan with input from teachers, classified staff, and parents. She supports district safety planning that addresses physical security, emergency preparedness, cybersecurity, and students’ social-emotional well-being.
Student Academic Growth: Leticia supports high academic expectations while ensuring students have access to meaningful learning opportunities. During her career, she developed partnerships with local organizations that expanded enrichment programs and learning experiences beyond the traditional school day. She believes all students should have opportunities to reach their full academic potential.
Fiscal Responsibility: Leticia has strong experience in developing and managing school budgets. She supports responsible stewardship of public resources and believes sound financial decisions should prioritize student learning, maintain essential programs, retain qualified educators, and pursue adequate funding for public education.
Teacher and Staff Support: Leticia recognizes the essential role teachers, classified employees, and administrators play in student success. She supports including educators in district decision-making and values their professional expertise and perspectives.
Family Engagement: Leticia believes families are important partners in education. She supports open communication, meaningful parent involvement, and collaboration between schools, families, and the broader community.
Ensuring All Students Feel Valued, Respected, and Welcomed: Leticia supports learning environments where every student is treated with dignity, respect, and inclusion. She is committed to working collaboratively with students, families, educators, and community members to help create schools where all students have the opportunity to learn, belong, and succeed.

text: Norma Lozoya-Toothman is focused on academic excellence, fiscal responsibility of public resources, and always putting children’s physical and emotional safety first.

The Chula Vista Elementary School District is failing the essential needs of the children who walk through the doors each day. Our students deserve safe learning environments, strong academic foundations, and the support that allows them to grow with confidence and a sense of belonging.
Norma Lozoya-Toothman is a mother, grandmother, and lifelong Chula Vista resident who believes our schools must reflect the values, hopes, and everyday realities of the families they serve.
Norma Lozoya-Toothman is here to listen to parents and act on behalf of our children!

Norma Lozoya-Toothman is an active community advocate with more than 25 years of experience in public service, committed to strengthening Chula Vista and supporting the families who call it home. Her work has centered on integrity, fairness, and ensuring that public institutions serve people effectively. As a member of the City of Chula Vista Charter Review Commission,
Lozoya-Toothman
evaluated
and recommended improvements that advanced transparency and accountability. As a member of the City’s Board of Ethics, she upheld ethical standards in public decision-making, which is severely lacking at the Chula Vista Elementary School District.

Norma Lozoya-Toothman has led youth mentorship programs, leadership initiatives, and anti-violence workshops for middle and high school students reinforcing her belief that strong communities are built on trust, openness, and responsible governance. These experiences strengthened her commitment to creating safe, supportive, and academically rigorous environments where every child can thrive. All students deserve access to high-quality education, strong academic standards, and meaningful opportunities that prepare them for future success.

Norma Lozoya-Toothman grew up in Chula Vista, raised her children here, and now her grandchildren. As a mother and grandmother, she is deeply vested in the well-being and success of our neighborhood children. Every student deserves the opportunity to discover their strengths and reach their full potential. Norma will allow for constructive conversations between families, educators, and community partners so every student feels supported, safe, and empowered to succeed.
Every Child, Every School, Every Family
Please vote for Norma Lozoya-Toothman for Chula Vista Elementary School Board – she will be your voice!
Please visit www.normalozoyatoothman.com for more information.
